PrismPulse 1.0.1 · 流光频谱
- 频谱严格贴住屏幕边界，去掉内部留白。顶部向下展开，左右自动旋转为纵向并朝屏幕内部展开。 - 「贴边长度」按屏幕宽度的 10%–100% 缩放，纵向长度限制在屏幕高度内。 - 新增应用内自动检查更新与「检查更新…」。从 GitHub 获取新版本，经签名验证后下载、安装并重启。 - 更新检查默认每天一次，可在设置中关闭。更新安装需要用户确认。 - PrismPulse now draws flush against every screen edge, mirrors at the top, and rotates inward on the left and right. - Scale the length from 10% to 100% of the display width. Vertical length is capped at the display height. - Built-in Sparkle updates check GitHub for new signed releases and handle downloading, installation, and relaunch.
需要 macOS 14.4 或更新版本。通用包支持 Apple Silicon 和 Intel。 Requires macOS 14.4 or later. Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel.
0.7 及更早版本请先手动下载并安装 1.0，后续可在应用内更新。 Users on 0.7 or earlier need to install 1.0 manually once to enable in-app updates.
本版本采用临时签名，未经 Apple 公证。首次打开方式见 README。 The app is ad hoc signed and has not been notarized by Apple. See the README for first-launch instructions.
修复 GitHub 更新入口的 504 兼容性问题，签名更新信息改为通过仓库原始文件获取。 Fix feed delivery on networks where GitHub latest/download returns 504.
